statement: 临时 CI runner 每次生成不同 debug keystore 会让设备把后续测试 APK 视为不同签名应用。快速测试构建应稳定复用 debug signing identity，而生产 release key 必须保持独立私密。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record OPS.ANDROID.STABLE_DEBUG_SIGNING; support threshold intentionally exceeds current independent evidence by one group.

review.rationale: Evidence-insufficient Experimental record modeled without promotion; additional independent evidence is required by policy.
